format.title: Format Rule
rules: Every TikTok post must be exactly 5 slides.
Optimize for swipe-through to Slide 5, not just views.

slide2.title: Slide 2 Reward Rule
rules: Slide 2 MUST reward that curiosity immediately.
Slide 2 must clearly explain the mechanism or opportunity.
The offer must be clear by Slide 2.
goodExamples: People pay to have their resumes cleaned up before they apply.
AI helps with the wording, bullets, and keywords.
You offer a simple service business around resume cleanup.
You are not writing from scratch. You are cleaning up what they already have.

use: make money helping people with resumes

slideGoals.slide2: Explain the mechanism. Make the offer clear.
slideGoals.slide5: Ask for a low-pressure action (Comment RESUME).

funnel: comments → DMs → free checklist downloads → $20 guide sales
